tail:
VERDICT: CLEAN

BOUNDARY: Checked boundary cases: A empty (then U=ℝ, G=∅, E_ε=∅), A=ℝ, f unbounded (oscillation can be +∞; infimum inequalities hold), ε>0, and oscillation taking extended values -∞ (only for empty subsets). The openness argument for U uses the triangle inequality and monotonicity of ω_f; it does not require nonempty intersections. The infimum reasoning (steps 2.2–2.3) correctly applies greatest-lower-bound properties in ℝ̅, and the case where A∩N_δ(x) is empty never occurs for x∈A because x belongs to every such neighborhood. No division, no choice, no hidden circularity.

SOURCES: Inspected the five cited items in full: def-oscillation (provides L1, monotonicity, point-oscillation definition), def-open-and-closed-in-r (provides L4), def-neighbourhood-r (provides L3 via nesting), def-extended-reals (gives the ordered set ℝ̅ and its basic properties), lem-extended-reals-complete (gives L2, existence of infima/suprema in ℝ̅). The properties used in the proof exactly match the supplied definitions and lemmas.

CHECKED: Title, public claim, all numbered proof steps (1.1, 2.1–2.3, 3.1, 4.1, 5.1), and the Remarks. Each inference is logically valid, and the explicit construction G = ℝ \ U works.
